method: In a disposable local LibreCAD clone, checked out the pinned base, applied the 12 documented patch artifacts in commit order with git apply --check before each application, and compared the resulting worktree against the target commit using a separate Git index.
result: All 12 forward checks and applications passed; the resulting tracked worktree had no differences from the target commit.
limits: This checks exact patch reproducibility at the pinned base only. It does not establish applicability to a newer upstream consumer head, build or runtime behavior, or completion of P8-D. The downstream branch remains local and unmerged.
